name: Get around town on Harborline Transit
context: Harborline Transit operates twelve bus routes connecting the harbor district, the university, and the outlying neighborhoods. Buses run every ten to twenty minutes on weekdays and every thirty minute…

name: Plan your trip
context: Use the routes page to find a bus near you, or check the schedules page for departure times at your stop.

name: Service alerts
context: Detours and delays are posted as soon as they are known. Check the alerts page before you head out during storms or major events.

name: Fares
context: A single ride costs two dollars and fifty cents. Weekly and monthly passes are available at the harbor terminal ticket window and through the mobile app.

name: Routes
context: Harborline Transit runs twelve numbered routes across the city. Select a route below to see its full path and stops.

name: Accessible vehicles
context: Every bus in the fleet is equipped with a low floor and a fold-out ramp. Priority seating is available near the front doors.

name: Bike racks
context: Each bus carries a two-bike rack on the front bumper at no extra charge.

name: Service alerts
context: Current detours and delays affecting Harborline Transit routes are listed below, most recent first.

name: Route 142 detour
context: Bridge repairs have closed River Street between Third and Sixth. Route 142 buses are using Dock Street until repairs finish next month.

name: Route 219 delays
context: Expect delays of five to ten minutes on Route 219 during the morning commute while a signal is repaired at Northgate and Fifth.

name: Holiday schedule
context: All routes run on a reduced Sunday schedule for the harbor festival on the third weekend of the month.

name: Bus schedules
context: Weekday and weekend departure times for every route are published here on the first of each month.

name: Weekday service
context: Buses depart the harbor terminal every ten minutes from six in the morning until seven at night, then every twenty minutes until midnight.

name: Weekend service
context: Saturday and Sunday buses run every thirty minutes from seven in the morning until midnight.

name: Printable timetables
context: A printable timetable for each route is available at the harbor terminal information counter.

name: Board of Directors meeting minutes
context: The Harborline Transit Authority board meets on the second Tuesday of each month. Minutes and public comment records are archived here going back ten years.

name: Most recent meeting
context: The board approved next year's operating budget and discussed the proposed extension of Route 219 to the north industrial park.

name: Public comment
context: Written comments may be submitted before any meeting through the contact page. Spoken comments are limited to three minutes per speaker.

name: Archive
context: Older minutes are grouped by year below the current listing.

name: Route 204 — Crosstown Limited
context: Route 204 connects the harbor terminal to the university campus with limited stops, cutting the trip to eighteen minutes at peak times.

name: Stops
context: Harbor Terminal, Fifth and Main, University Gate, Campus Center.

name: Frequency
context: Buses run every fifteen minutes on weekdays and are not in service on weekends.

name: Fleet
context: Route 204 is served by the newer low-floor articulated buses with extra standing room for the campus commute.
